positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Started off with UI in Unity on Atlas Reactor.
Quickly moved into server/client work.
Eventually got into matchmaking, and feature implementation.
Moved onto Trove as a generalist engineer with a focus on UI work, in C++ and IggyUI.
Moved onto Defiance 2050 as a generalist engineer, with a focus on gameplay.

positions.description: I develop code for a variety of purposes. The vast majority of the code I write is in PHP.

positions.description: I wrote code to help the company in various projects. The vast majority of my code was in C++.

projects.title: StumbleUpon Paid Discovery Ad System Launch
projects.description: A company-wide effort to completely rebuild existing ad platform generating all revenue for StumbleUpon from scratch, changed and refocused the target market, and completely rebranded it. 18 months after launch, revenue increased by 4X, pushing company to profitability. Absolutely would not have been possible with a world-class team who worked tirelessly to launch and support.
